mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at the Verona Area High School are overcast with a temperature of 54 degrees. The moon is currently in a waxing crescent phase. While the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will see an overnight low of 54 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has officially designated four polling locations for residents, including the Sugar River United Methodist Church and the Verona Public Library. It is important to visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm your specific ward and polling location before you head out, as locations may have changed since last year.

There is plenty happening in the community. Tomorrow, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 Thursday nights, or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, Friday features live music at Bailey's Run, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square this Saturday.

Regarding local public safety, a noteworthy incident occurred on October 7th, where a 17-year-old riding an e-moto collided with a vehicle on Basswood Avenue. The juvenile sustained minor injuries, and their parent was cited for permitting an unauthorized minor to operate the motorcycle.

Today's flavor of the day was Dark Chocolate Decadence. Since we are closed for the evening, we invite you to stop by tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM to enjoy our next flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough.
